jobs.title: Software engineer met affiniteit voor de veehouderij
jobs.description:
Jouw baan

Ben jij een software engineer die verder kijkt dan alleen code? Heb je een praktische achtergrond of sterke affiniteit met de veehouderij en wil je jouw technische skills inzetten om de agrarische sector slimmer en duurzamer te maken? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Wat ga je doen?

Als software engineer werk je aan innovatieve digitale oplossingen voor de veehouderij. Denk aan simulatieprogramma’s om scenarioanalyses uit te voeren, applicaties voor dataverzameling en -analyse en managementsystemen voor veehouderijbedrijven (digital twins). Je vertaalt praktijkvragen naar slimme software en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit zowel de IT als de agrarische praktijk.

Jouw Taken

ontwikkelen en onderhouden van software (bijvoorbeeld webapplicaties, dashboards of andere software instrumenten);
vertalen van praktijkbehoeften van onderzoekers en adviseurs naar technische oplossingen;
samenwerken met onderzoekers, adviseurs en eindgebruikers;
testen en verbeteren van bestaande systemen;
ontwikkelen en onderhouden van software (bijvoorbeeld webapplicaties, dashboards of andere software instrumenten).

Jouw team

Binnen de afdeling Animal Farming Systems ga je samenwerken met een onderzoeksteam van 35 zeer gemotiveerde projectleiders, onderzoekers en projectassistenten. We staan bekend om onze innovatieve en integrale aanpak in het ontwerpen en evalueren van de duurzaamheid van dierhouderijsystemen. Je werkt samen met collega’s uit je eigen team en collega’s van andere afdelingen of onderzoeksinstituten in projectteamverband.

Hier ga je werken

Je gaat werken op de groenste en meest innovatieve campus van Nederland, en op een universiteit die 20 keer is gekozen tot de “beste universiteit” van Nederland en ook wereldwijd gezien wordt als de beste universiteit op het agrofooddomein.

Jouw kwaliteiten

Jij hebt een analytisch denkvermogen en een oplossingsgerichte mindset. Daarnaast beschik je over goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding.

Ook beschik jij over: 

een afgeronde HBO-opleiding gericht op informatica, dierhouderij of agrarisch ondernemerschap;
ervaring in het ontwikkelen van software met bijvoorbeeld C# of Python;
affiniteit met en interesse in de veehouderijsector.

In onze internationale werkomgeving wordt steeds meer in het Engels gecommuniceerd. Voor deze functie gaat het om taalniveau C1. Heb je dit niveau nog niet, dan helpen wij je vanzelfsprekend en kun je terecht bij ons taalcentrum Wageningen in’to Language.

Je ziet dat er voldoende uitdagingen voor jou liggen. Deze uitdagingen kunnen ook als ontwikkelmogelijkheden gezien worden. Mocht jij dus nog niet het track-record hebben dat in de vacature wordt gevraagd, maar wél solide werkervaring hebben, dan willen we jou ook graag uitnodigen om te solliciteren.

Wij bieden

Als het gaat om arbeidsvoorwaarden zit je goed bij Wageningen University & Research. Highlights uit onze CAO zijn: 

werktijden die in overleg kunnen worden vastgesteld, zodat een optimale balans tussen werk en privé mogelijk is; 
sabbatical leave, studieverlof en deels betaald ouderschapverlof; 
er is veel aandacht voor vitaliteit en je kan, tegen een aantrekkelijk tarief, gebruik maken van de op de campus aanwezige sportfaciliteiten; 
een structurele eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%; 
uitstekende pensioenregeling via ABP.  

Bij deze uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden hoort natuurlijk ook een passend salaris. Wij bieden afhankelijk van je ervaring, een marktconform salaris van minimaal € 3.381,- tot maximaal € 5.132,- bij een volledige werkweek van 36 uur conform CAO Wageningen Research (schaal 8-9). De inschaling is afhankelijk van relevante ervaring en opleidingsachtergrond. Voor deze rol is een aanstelling van 32 tot 36 uur bespreekbaar. Als het gaat om je contract bieden we in eerste instantie een jaarcontract aan dat – als dat mogelijk is binnen de (bedrijfseconomische) organisatieomstandigheden - bij goed functioneren verlengd kan worden.

We stimuleren ontwikkeling en mobiliteit binnen onze organisatie. In ons werving- en selectiebeleid lees je welke voorwaarden specifiek voor jou gelden als (oud) medewerker. Heb je hierover vragen, dan helpen we je graag.

Je werkt op de groenste en meest innovatieve campus van Nederland, in een internationale en open werksfeer.

Belangrijke informatie

Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Frank Gort, hoofd afdeling Dierhouderijsystemen, via telefoonnummer: 06-81028847 of via e-mail: frank.gort@wur.nl (mailto:frank.gort@wur.nl).

Vragen over de procedure? Neem contact op met Dax Teunissen, corporate recruiter, via e-mail: recruitment.asg@wur.nl (mailto:recruitment.asg@wur.nl).

Solliciteren?

Klik op de sollicitatiebutton bij de vacature op onze website. Alleen sollicitaties via onze website worden in behandeling genomen.

Reageren kan tot en met
zondag 27 september 2026
. Bij voorkeur solliciteren interne kandidaten vóór 1 augustus 2026.

Wij beoordelen binnengekomen reacties doorlopend, ook vóór de sluitingsdatum. Daarom kan het voorkomen dat de vacature eerder wordt gesloten dan vermeld.

Welkom, veilig en gewaardeerd

Wageningen University & Research (WUR) hecht grote waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie. Dit omdat we geloven dat verschillende inzichten leiden tot innovatieve oplossingen. We creëren daarom een werkomgeving waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig en gewaardeerd voelt, ongeacht achtergrond, identiteit of ervaring. Samen bouwen we aan een cultuur waarin ieders unieke bijdrage bijdraagt aan het succes van onze organisatie.

Wij zijn

De missie van Wageningen University & Research is ‘To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life’. Binnen Wageningen University & Research bundelen Wageningen University en gespecialiseerde onderzoeksinstituten van Stichting Wageningen Research hun krachten om bij te dragen aan de oplossing van belangrijke vragen in het domein van gezonde voeding en leefomgeving. Met ongeveer 30 vestigingen, 7.600 medewerkers (6.700 fte) en 13.100 studenten en ruim 150.000 Leven Lang Leren-deelnemers behoort Wageningen University & Research wereldwijd tot de aansprekende kennisinstellingen binnen haar domein. De integrale benadering van de vraagstukken en de samenwerking tussen verschillende disciplines vormen het hart van de unieke Wageningen aanpak.

Deze punten geven onze medewerkers aan als goede redenen om te komen werken bij WUR: lees de 6 redenen om te komen werken bij WUR (https://www.wur.nl/nl/Werken-bij/Daarom-werken-bij-Wageningen-University-Research.htm)

Wij werven zelf voor deze vacature. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld, maar delen in je netwerk wel.

jobs.title: Software Engineer with an Affinity for Livestock Farming
jobs.description:
Your job

Are you a software engineer who looks beyond just code? Do you have a practical background or strong affinity with livestock farming and do you want to use your technical skills to make the agricultural sector smarter and more sustainable? Then we are looking for you.

What will you do?

As a software engineer, you will work on innovative digital solutions for livestock farming. Think of simulation programs to perform scenario analyses, applications for data collection and analysis and management systems for livestock farms (digital twins). You translate practical questions into smart software and work closely with colleagues from both IT and agricultural background.

Your Tasks

developing and maintaining software (e.g. web applications, dashboards or other software tools);
translating the practical needs of researchers and consultants into technical solutions;
collaborate with researchers, advisors and end users;
testing and improving existing systems;
thinking about innovations within the sector.

Your team

Within the Animal Farming Systems department, you will work together with a research team of 35 highly motivated project leaders, researchers and project assistants. We are known for our innovative and integrated approach in designing and evaluating the sustainability of animal farming systems. You will work together with colleagues from your own team and colleagues from other Wageningen Livestock Research departments or WUR research institutes in a project team.

This is where you will work

You will work on the greenest and most innovative campus in the Netherlands, and at a university that has been voted the "best university" in the Netherlands 20 times and is also seen worldwide as the best university in the agri-food domain.

Your qualities

You have analytical thinking skills and a solution-oriented mindset. In addition, you have good communication skills and a proactive attitude.

You Also Have

a completed bachelor focused on computer science, animal husbandry or agricultural entrepreneurship;
experience in developing software with e.g. C# or Python;
affinity with and interest in the livestock sector.

In our international working environment, communication is increasingly in English. This position involves language level (https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages/table-1-cefr-3.3-common-reference-levels-global-scale) C1. If you do not yet have this level, we will of course help you and you can contact our language center Wageningen in'to Language (https://www.wur.nl/nl/onderwijs-opleidingen/wageningen-into-languages.htm).

You can see that there are plenty of challenges for you. These challenges can also be seen as development opportunities. So if you do not yet have the track record required in the vacancy, but do have solid work experience, we would also like to invite you to apply.

We offer

Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/conditions-of-employment). A few highlights from our Collective Labour Agreement include:

working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance;
sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave;
there is a strong focus on vitality and you can make use of the sports facilities available on campus for a small fee;
a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%;
excellent pension scheme.

In addition to these first-rate employee benefits, you will of course receive a good salary. We offer, depending on your experience, a competitive gross salary of between € 3,381.- and € 5,132.- for a full-time working week of 36 hours, in accordance with the CLA Wageningen Research (scale 8/9). Additionally, for this role a contract of 32 to 36 hours can be discussed. We initially offer a one-year contract, with the possibility of renewal subject to satisfactory performance and depending on the organisation’s financial situation.

We encourage development and internal mobility within our organisation. Our recruitment and selection policy sets out the conditions that apply specifically to you as a (former) employee. If you have any questions, we are happy to help.

Coming from abroad

WUR welcomes applications from international candidates. However, for applicants for this specific position from outside the EU/EFTA zone, immigration restrictions may apply based on Dutch and EU immigration laws. Such candidates may be eligible for an “ orientation year ” in the Netherlands or a visa as a “ knowledge migrant ”.

Wageningen University & Research is the university and research centre for life sciences. The themes we deal with are relevant to everyone around the world and Wageningen, therefore, has a large international community and a lot to offer to international employees.

Because we expect you to work and live in the Netherlands our team of advisors on Dutch immigration procedures will help you with the visa application procedures for yourself and, if applicable, for your family. If you come with a partner, we offer a Dual Career group program organized by our Welcome Center (https://wcfv.nl/en/home/global/our-services/happy-landing-and-living/). This program helps your partner to get familiar with the Dutch culture, labour market and assists your partner to find a job.

Feeling welcome also has everything to do with being well informed. Wageningen University & Research's International Community (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/expats-new-international-staff) page contains practical information about what we can do to support international employees coming to Wageningen. Furthermore, our Welcome Center can assist you with any additional advice and information about for example housing, opening a bank account or schooling. Finally, certain categories of international staff may be eligible for a tax exemption on a part of their salary during the first five years in the Netherlands.

Important information

For more information about the position, please contact ir. Frank Gort, Head of the Department of Animal Production Systems, via phone number: +31 681028847 or via email: frank.gort@wur.nl (mailto:frank.gort@wur.nl).

Questions about the procedure? Get in touch with Dax Teunissen, Corporate Recruiter, via email: recruitment.asg@wur.nl (mailto:recruitment.asg@wur.nl).

Ready to apply?

Click on the application button next to the vacancy on our website. Only applications submitted through our website will be considered.

You can apply up to and including Sunday September 27, 2026
. Internal candidates are preferred to apply before August 1, 2026.

Applications are reviewed regularly. Therefore, the position may be filled before the stated closing date.

Welcome, safe, and valued

Wageningen University & Research (WUR) highly values diversity and inclusion because we believe that different insights lead to innovative solutions. We create a work environment where everyone feels welcome, safe, and appreciated, regardless of background, identity, or experience. Together, we are building a culture where everyone's unique contribution adds to the success of our organization.

We are

The mission of Wageningen University & Research is “To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life”. Under the banner Wageningen University & Research, Wageningen University and the specialised research institutes of the Wageningen Research Foundation have joined forces in contributing to finding solutions to important questions in the domain of healthy food and living environment. With its roughly 30 branches, 7,600 employees (6,700 fte) and 13,100 students and over 150,000 participants to WUR’s Life Long Learning, Wageningen University & Research is one of the leading organisations in its domain. The unique Wageningen approach lies in its integrated approach to issues and the collaboration between different disciplines.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Over de functie

In het kort: Je gaat als projectarchitect Salesforce-, AFAS- en Azure-integratieoplossingen ontwerpen, coördineren en bewaken, solution architectuurdocumenten opstellen, DevOps-teams verbinden, architectuurkaders uitdragen en de impact van grote programma’s vertalen naar duidelijke richting voor stakeholders.

Volgens Kadaster richtlijn dient iedere medewerker minimaal 2 dagen per week op kantoor aanwezig te zijn. Welke dagen dit zijn gaat in overleg met de manager en het team.

Kadaster

Het Kadaster registreert en verstrekt gegevens over de ligging van vastgoed in Nederland en de daarmee samenhangende rechten, zoals eigendom en hypotheek. Als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan is dat onze wettelijke taak. Onze gegevens bieden houvast bij het onderzoeken van maatschappelijke vraagstukken, of het nu gaat om de beste route voor een nieuwe snelweg, actuele ontwikkelingen op de woningmarkt of het in beeld brengen van leegstand.

Opdracht

Binnen Beheer en Ontwikkeling IT werken we met Scrum en DevOps en zijn de teams integraal verantwoordelijk voor de volledige technische dienstverlening, van idee tot productie. Vanuit een dynamische omgeving bieden wij een informele werksfeer. Soms werkt het beter om even je zinnen te verzetten en kan je met je teamgenoten een potje tafeltennis spelen, gamen of met de 3D printer een ontwerp realiseren. Ook hebben we een innovation hub om in een andere sfeer samen te werken.

Omschrijving de unit en afdeling waarbinnen de inhuurkracht komt te werken

Binnen de directie Beheer en ontwikkeling IT is de afdeling BSU3 verantwoordelijk voor de ondersteuning van de interne bedrijfsvoering van Kadaster. De diensten worden door een groot aantal teams ontwikkeld en onderhouden. Het Salesforce/AFAS Team is één van de teams binnen deze afdeling.

Het team Salesforce/AFAS is op zoek naar een Project architect.

In de rol van Project Architect heb je een brede visie op de huidige en toekomstige ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot o.a. Salesforce, AFAS, Azure Integration Services en Cloud. Je bent mede verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en realiseren van een efficiënte, stabiele en toekomstbestendige IT-oplossingen bij het Kadaster.

Als projectarchitect werk je mee binnen meerdere project- en Devop teams. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het maken van ontwerpkeuzes en om eventuele afwijkingen op de architectuur terug te koppelen aan de betreffende Domein Architect. Hiernaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie alle werkzaamheden die binnen de unit BSU3 worden uitgevoerd op het gebied van Salesforce-, AFAS- en integratiearchitectuur (Azure Integration Services).

Belangrijkste technieken, methoden en tools

Visualiseren softwarearchitectuur in gelaagde niveaus ((Context, Containers, Componenten en Code), bv C4 modellering
Domain Driven Design(DDD): om de softwarestructuur nauw aan te sluiten bij de business-domeinlogica
Uses case modelling
Modelleringssoftware, bv. Enterprise Architect
Kennis van UML, integratiepatronen, securityprincipes en cloudarchitecturen
Jira

De belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn

Is verantwoordelijk om op basis van de Solution Architectuur, de Domain Architecturen, de door de Business aangeleverde inputproducten, de Use Case Specificaties en de impactanalyses een solution architectuur document (SAD) op te stellen.
Werkt actief mee aan solution en domainarchitectuur
Is samen met de andere architecten verantwoordelijk voor de architectural runway, technology roadmap en lifecycle management.
Heeft een duidelijke IT/architectuur-visie op het gebied van Salesforce, AFAS en Azure Integration Services (afdeling breed & domein overstijgend) en draagt deze ook uit bij de teams en zorgt voor draagvlak.
Draagt zorg voor een goede DevOps cultuur door teams te verbinden m.b.t. team overstijgende vraagstukken en de juiste koers uit te zetten tussen kwaliteit en de noodzaak om continu business waarde te genereren.
Weet kaders op het gebied van o.a. integratiestrategie, uniforme werkwijze (bijv. code kwaliteit, gebruik van patterns, best practices), security en performance op een effectieve en enthousiasmerende manier naar de teams te brengen en effectueren
Weet de impact van grote Salesforce- en AFAS-programma’s in andere domeinen op een effectieve manier te vertalen voor stakeholders en de teams.

Eisen

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (.NET / TypeScript)
jobs.description:
Position Description

At CGI, you'll help shape digital services that make a meaningful difference across the UK public sector. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll play a key role in enhancing a live, high-profile platform that supports a key regulatory body, delivering innovative solutions that improve user experiences and provide measurable value to our client. Working alongside a collaborative team of experts, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of technical delivery, contribute new ideas, and develop modern cloud-native solutions in an environment that supports your growth and recognises the impact you make.

CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK 'Best Employer' by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you'll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We'll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go.

Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This is a hybrid position where you'll be required to attend our Bristol office 2/3 days per week, as well as client site as required.

Your future duties and responsibilities

In this role, you will join a skilled delivery team responsible for enhancing and evolving a live digital service used by our key UK Government client. A sales-quota or renewals role. Account Management owns commercial relationships.

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer
. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.
Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.
Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.
Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.
Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.
Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.
Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view.
Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.
Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components.
Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.
Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments.
Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

What We're Looking For

Engineering foundation

8–10+ years of professional software development; back-end-heavy, full-stack capable.
Primary production experience in one of our core ecosystems: TypeScript / Node + React, Python, .NET / C#, or Java.
Strong in APIs, service design, event-driven / distributed systems, and data modeling.
Track record as a Solution Architect, Principal Engineer, or Tech Lead — can assess a current-state environment and define a credible roadmap.
Has designed and owned CI/CD — build, test, release, environments — not just used someone else’s pipeline.

Applied AI

Has built and shipped LLM and agent systems beyond a demo.
Deep fluency with agentic tooling: Claude Code, agent frameworks, MCP, tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration.
Context and spec engineering: structures codebases, specifications, process definitions, and context to produce reliable, context-efficient AI output.
Integration literacy: understands integration methods and options — APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS (n8n, MuleSoft, etc.), MCP — and the constraints and strategies behind connecting AI to systems of record. Doesn’t need to own every integration, but can design around them and guide the team that does.

Consulting & business

Demonstrates the discovery behaviors above: business and personal drivers, constraints, stakeholder alignment, strategic questioning.
Runs client conversations without an account manager in the room: workshops, proposal walkthroughs, hard questions, pushback.
Translates technical decisions into business outcomes — cycle time, cost per transaction, throughput, risk reduction, ROI.
Exceptional written and verbal communication; credible in front of senior stakeholders.

Strong Plus

Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.
Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.
Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing).

Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system.

Your job

Are you a software engineer who looks beyond just code? Do you have a practical background or strong affinity with livestock farming and do you want to use your technical skills to make the agricultural sector smarter and more sustainable? Then we are looking for you.

What will you do?

As a software engineer, you will work on innovative digital solutions for livestock farming. Think of simulation programs to perform scenario analyses, applications for data collection and analysis and management systems for livestock farms (digital twins). You translate practical questions into smart software and work closely with colleagues from both IT and agricultural background.

Your Tasks

developing and maintaining software (e.g. web applications, dashboards or other software tools);
translating the practical needs of researchers and consultants into technical solutions;
collaborate with researchers, advisors and end users;
testing and improving existing systems;
thinking about innovations within the sector.

Your team

Within the Animal Farming Systems department, you will work together with a research team of 35 highly motivated project leaders, researchers and project assistants. We are known for our innovative and integrated approach in designing and evaluating the sustainability of animal farming systems. You will work together with colleagues from your own team and colleagues from other Wageningen Livestock Research departments or WUR research institutes in a project team.

This is where you will work

You will work on the greenest and most innovative campus in the Netherlands, and at a university that has been voted the "best university" in the Netherlands 20 times and is also seen worldwide as the best university in the agri-food domain.

Your qualities

You have analytical thinking skills and a solution-oriented mindset. In addition, you have good communication skills and a proactive attitude.

You Also Have

a completed bachelor focused on computer science, animal husbandry or agricultural entrepreneurship;
experience in developing software with e.g. C# or Python;
affinity with and interest in the livestock sector.

In our international working environment, communication is increasingly in English. This position involves language level (https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages/table-1-cefr-3.3-common-reference-levels-global-scale) C1. If you do not yet have this level, we will of course help you and you can contact our language center Wageningen in'to Language (https://www.wur.nl/nl/onderwijs-opleidingen/wageningen-into-languages.htm).

You can see that there are plenty of challenges for you. These challenges can also be seen as development opportunities. So if you do not yet have the track record required in the vacancy, but do have solid work experience, we would also like to invite you to apply.

We offer

Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/conditions-of-employment). A few highlights from our Collective Labour Agreement include:

working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance;
sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave;
there is a strong focus on vitality and you can make use of the sports facilities available on campus for a small fee;
a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%;
excellent pension scheme.

In addition to these first-rate employee benefits, you will of course receive a good salary. We offer, depending on your experience, a competitive gross salary of between € 3,381.- and € 5,132.- for a full-time working week of 36 hours, in accordance with the CLA Wageningen Research (scale 8/9). Additionally, for this role a contract of 32 to 36 hours can be discussed. We initially offer a one-year contract, with the possibility of renewal subject to satisfactory performance and depending on the organisation’s financial situation.

We encourage development and internal mobility within our organisation. Our recruitment and selection policy sets out the conditions that apply specifically to you as a (former) employee. If you have any questions, we are happy to help.

Coming from abroad

WUR welcomes applications from international candidates. However, for applicants for this specific position from outside the EU/EFTA zone, immigration restrictions may apply based on Dutch and EU immigration laws. Such candidates may be eligible for an “ orientation year ” in the Netherlands or a visa as a “ knowledge migrant ”.

Wageningen University & Research is the university and research centre for life sciences. The themes we deal with are relevant to everyone around the world and Wageningen, therefore, has a large international community and a lot to offer to international employees.

Because we expect you to work and live in the Netherlands our team of advisors on Dutch immigration procedures will help you with the visa application procedures for yourself and, if applicable, for your family. If you come with a partner, we offer a Dual Career group program organized by our Welcome Center (https://wcfv.nl/en/home/global/our-services/happy-landing-and-living/). This program helps your partner to get familiar with the Dutch culture, labour market and assists your partner to find a job.

Feeling welcome also has everything to do with being well informed. Wageningen University & Research's International Community (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/expats-new-international-staff) page contains practical information about what we can do to support international employees coming to Wageningen. Furthermore, our Welcome Center can assist you with any additional advice and information about for example housing, opening a bank account or schooling. Finally, certain categories of international staff may be eligible for a tax exemption on a part of their salary during the first five years in the Netherlands.

Important information

For more information about the position, please contact ir. Frank Gort, Head of the Department of Animal Production Systems, via phone number: +31 681028847 or via email: frank.gort@wur.nl (mailto:frank.gort@wur.nl).

Questions about the procedure? Get in touch with Dax Teunissen, Corporate Recruiter, via email: recruitment.asg@wur.nl (mailto:recruitment.asg@wur.nl).

Ready to apply?

Click on the application button next to the vacancy on our website. Only applications submitted through our website will be considered.

You can apply up to and including Sunday September 27, 2026
. Internal candidates are preferred to apply before August 1, 2026.

Applications are reviewed regularly. Therefore, the position may be filled before the stated closing date.

Welcome, safe, and valued

Wageningen University & Research (WUR) highly values diversity and inclusion because we believe that different insights lead to innovative solutions. We create a work environment where everyone feels welcome, safe, and appreciated, regardless of background, identity, or experience. Together, we are building a culture where everyone's unique contribution adds to the success of our organization.

We are

The mission of Wageningen University & Research is “To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life”. Under the banner Wageningen University & Research, Wageningen University and the specialised research institutes of the Wageningen Research Foundation have joined forces in contributing to finding solutions to important questions in the domain of healthy food and living environment. With its roughly 30 branches, 7,600 employees (6,700 fte) and 13,100 students and over 150,000 participants to WUR’s Life Long Learning, Wageningen University & Research is one of the leading organisations in its domain. The unique Wageningen approach lies in its integrated approach to issues and the collaboration between different disciplines.

new_jobs.description:
We're hiring a Customer Success Engineer to help customers turn our product into part of their everyday work. You'll combine practical customer success with building the systems, communications and learning experiences that make adoption repeatable.

About Us

Fifth Dimension builds AI software for the firms that invest in and manage real assets. We help people work with complex documents and business data, from leases and financial models to investment memos. We're a Series A company with offices in London, New York and Singapore.

Our values are Own It, Ship It and Don't Be Boring
. We move quickly, challenge each other kindly and care about making something customers actually use.

The Challenge

A useful product does not automatically become a useful daily habit. Customers need to connect their data, complete a valuable piece of work and come back to do it again. Your job is to make those steps easier, then make them work consistently across customers.

Imagine several customers are getting stuck connecting Microsoft 365. You help one through the setup, identify the shared problem, improve the guidance and follow-ups, and check whether more people reach their first useful result.

About You

You like helping people and making things. When the same question comes up twice, you start thinking about a better way to answer it. You can learn a technical product, explain it clearly and follow a problem through without waiting for a perfect brief.

You've probably spent one to three years in a technical customer role, implementation, support or operations. Strong projects, internships or your own business can demonstrate the same ability.

Your Impact

A practical individual contributor role, working directly with our CTO and closely with Customer Success, Account Management, Product and Engineering.
A builder who learns from individual customer problems and creates solutions that help many customers.
Ownership of onboarding, adoption programs and routine-support improvements, with experienced colleagues to learn from.

What This Role Is Not

A sales-quota or renewals role. Account Management owns commercial relationships.
A role spent solely answering tickets. You need time to build the systems that reduce repeat questions.
A senior software-engineering or bespoke enterprise-implementation role.

Day to Day, You Will

Build adoption programs: onboarding sequences, useful prompts and follow-ups based on what customers have actually done.
Improve first-line support: handle questions, find recurring issues, maintain useful guidance and build AI-assisted answers and routing, with tested output and clear human escalation.
Teach customers: run onboarding, webinars and office hours; make short videos, examples and guides people can use independently.
Make product releases useful: explain what changed, reach the people who will benefit and check whether they use it.
Troubleshoot: investigate configuration and integration issues, fix what you can and give engineers clear reproductions when the product needs to change.
Measure progress: track time to first value, repeat use and the manual work removed. Use the evidence to decide what to improve next.

What We're Looking For

Something useful you built yourself: an automation, small tool or integration you can explain and improve.
Practical AI use, with a habit of testing answers and checking what your tools produce.
Clear writing, patient teaching and confidence working directly with customers.
Comfort connecting tools and data through APIs, webhooks, scripting or automation platforms.
Reliable follow-through and enough data confidence to tell whether your work helped.

Nice To Have (But Not Required)

Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, product analytics, SQL or lifecycle communications.
Experience running training or supporting a specialist professional product.
Real estate or investment-management knowledge. You can learn the domain here.

Your First Few Months

Month 1. You can lead an onboarding session, have investigated real customer questions and have shipped your first useful automation or adoption improvement.
Month 3. A repeatable onboarding or feature-adoption program is running. You can show customers reaching value faster, using a valuable process more consistently, or the team doing less repetitive work.
Month 6. The programs you own reliably serve more customers without a matching rise in manual effort. You can explain which interventions improve sustained use and which you stopped. You and Chen will set targets from the starting baseline.

What We Offer You

Salary: £50,000–£70,000, plus equity. Hybrid, 2-3 days a week in the office.

Enhanced pension contributions and private healthcare through BUPA.
Generous paid time off and a two-week company shutdown in December.
Enhanced parental leave: 14 weeks for the primary caregiver and six for the secondary caregiver.
Direct access to experienced technical and customer colleagues, with meaningful ownership from the start.

About FullStack

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer
. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.
Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.
Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.
Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.
Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.
Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.
Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view.
Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.
Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components.
Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.
Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments.
Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

What We're Looking For

Engineering foundation

8–10+ years of professional software development; back-end-heavy, full-stack capable.
Primary production experience in one of our core ecosystems: TypeScript / Node + React, Python, .NET / C#, or Java.
Strong in APIs, service design, event-driven / distributed systems, and data modeling.
Track record as a Solution Architect, Principal Engineer, or Tech Lead — can assess a current-state environment and define a credible roadmap.
Has designed and owned CI/CD — build, test, release, environments — not just used someone else’s pipeline.

Applied AI

Has built and shipped LLM and agent systems beyond a demo.
Deep fluency with agentic tooling: Claude Code, agent frameworks, MCP, tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration.
Context and spec engineering: structures codebases, specifications, process definitions, and context to produce reliable, context-efficient AI output.
Integration literacy: understands integration methods and options — APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS (n8n, MuleSoft, etc.), MCP — and the constraints and strategies behind connecting AI to systems of record. Doesn’t need to own every integration, but can design around them and guide the team that does.

Consulting & business

Demonstrates the discovery behaviors above: business and personal drivers, constraints, stakeholder alignment, strategic questioning.
Runs client conversations without an account manager in the room: workshops, proposal walkthroughs, hard questions, pushback.
Translates technical decisions into business outcomes — cycle time, cost per transaction, throughput, risk reduction, ROI.
Exceptional written and verbal communication; credible in front of senior stakeholders.

Strong Plus

Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.
Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.
Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing).
